text:
anya: Heads-up: branching relnotes for v0.12.0 — features: model pinning + autoscale controls. Need docs PR + SDK snippets. Who can own the release notes draft?

matt: I can draft the what's-new blurb + known-issues. Will need example SDK usage for pinning (py + go).

simone: I'll do the SDK snippets. Prefer to put python + go in the same PR. Any preferred pattern for pin API? current idea: `pin(model="redwood-1.2")` option.

chris: product note: pinning is gated by feature flag for early access. Also known issue: pinning doesn't work with some quantized model variants — call that out in KNOWN ISSUES and add rollout guidance.

anya: Thanks. Matt: aim for a single-paragraph blurb + 3 bullet callouts (what's new, migration, known issues). Simone: paste code snippets here, then link PR.

simone: Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(
    "Tell me a joke",
    model="redwood-v1.2",
    pin_model=True,
)
print(resp.text)
```

simone: Go snippet:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(nil)
resp, _ := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateParams{
    Prompt: "Tell me a joke",
    Model: "redwood-v1.2",
    PinModel: true,
})
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

docs-bot: new PR created: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4356 — relnotes draft + snippets

rik: I'll review links/anchors tomorrow. Watch for redirect from `/docs/models#pinning` -> `/docs/serving/pinning`. Also add a short migration guide for Dedicated customers using autoscale overrides.

matt: Draft here's the blurb:
"Model pinning lets you lock a route to a specific model version so you can maintain consistent outputs during rollouts. Also added autoscale controls to Dedicated so teams can set baseline GPU min/max per pool."

matt: bullets added in PR: - Quick start snippet - Migration note for pinned customers - Known issue: incompatible with quantized variants (workaround: use non-quantized build or temporary routing policy)

anya: Good. Add link to the autoscale policy docs and to the rollout guide. Also add a short note: customers on Dedicated with custom routing may need to update their policies.

simone: pushed SDK snippet PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/4358

release-bot: docs freeze set for Thu 2026-03-26 15:00 UTC

matt: added known-issue repro steps and recommended fallback:
1) If pin fails on quantized model, set `pin_model=false` and add route fallback to compatible family.
2) File an infra ticket for trying non-quantized variant.

rik: Linkcheck run queued. I'll post results here. If anchor mismatches show up, I'll add redirects in netlify config.

anya: Checklist: 1) docs PR open (done) 2) SDK snippet merged (in flight) 3) migration guide added (in PR) 4) linkcheck green 5) relnotes merged before freeze

chris: pinging sales for a heads-up to top Dedicated customers. Also notify support about the quantized limitation.

anya: SG. I'll merge the relnotes after Rik's approval. :thumbsup:
